parameters.description: Bogus Creek (Siskiyou Co.), a Klamath River tributary near Hornbrook that is an important Chinook and coho salmon spawning stream, does not have its own listed season/bag table. Anglers must instead follow the special regulations set for the Klamath River in 14 CCR §7.40(b)(50), which governs anadromous waters of the Klamath River basin.

candidates.summary: Bogus Creek has no independent season/bag rule; it follows the Klamath River special regulations table at 7.40(b)(50)

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Anglers 16 years of age or older must have a valid California sport fishing license.

candidates.summary: California sport fishing license required for anglers 16+
